messages.subject: Volvo Group Thailand | Sustainable transport, infrastructure and external affairs
messages.body:
Dear Volvo Group Thailand Leadership Team,

Volvo Group's focus on sustainable transport and infrastructure aligns with my experience leading stakeholder, regulatory and ESG execution within a complex multinational industrial environment.

At AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department. I lead senior engagement with ministries, regulators, communities and industry partners and coordinate internal responses across operations, HSE, environment, legal, finance, HR, procurement, security and technical teams.

My recent experience includes supporting the governance and external dimensions of approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, as well as carbon-data readiness from operating records. I also manage regulatory submissions, official visits, commitments and issue escalation. The result is an executive profile centered on moving complex transition priorities through institutions and operating systems.

I would value consideration for Thailand or ASEAN roles spanning External Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, Government Relations or Country Strategy. I have attached a Volvo Group-focused executive CV and would appreciate your routing it to the relevant Thailand or regional leadership team.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
